items.title: Migrate story-init, scope-plan, implementer, delivery, and evaluator role assets
items.context: Use the frozen Story 1 registry and Story 2 trusted full-context assembly; do not redefine role status or Task Context schema.
items.userSees: 用户看到五个复杂角色均显示 modular Prompt Envelope dispatch receipt，且 role/status/Task Context 字段与迁移前一致。

happy.desc: 每个复杂角色都由 registry 解析到 modular Prompt Envelope 并完成真实 dispatch

edge.desc: legacy role alias 与缺省可选字段仍能绑定同一 Task Context

adversarial.desc: 篡改 role 或 Task Context digest 时 dispatch/review gate 拒绝并留下结构化证据

items.title: Apply complex-role prompt budgets with nonblocking violation recording
items.context: Use observe/warn semantics for complex roles; correctness-critical full review must remain available when a budget is exceeded.
items.userSees: 用户看到复杂角色 prompt budget 的 observe/warn 结果和结构化 budget violation；即使超限，系统仍继续完整 correctness review。

happy.desc: 预算内 prompt 记录 usage 与预算状态并继续 dispatch

edge.desc: 预算超限只记录 violation/reason，不阻塞 full review

adversarial.desc: 将 warn 误改为 blocking gate 时回归测试失败

items.title: Run real dispatch A/B for every migrated complex role
items.context: Compare legacy/full or modular paths with provider usage, cache, latency, and output evidence; unavailable provider dimensions remain INCONCLUSIVE rather than zero.

items.title: Verify delivery, scope, authorship, evaluator, permission, and signature invariants
items.context: Acceptance requires no regression in delivery promises, scope gaps, implementer author, evaluator evidence, role-gated mutations, signed runs, and Task Context binding.
